name: Black Racers Yearbook
whyMatch: Smithsonian National Museum of American History confirms it holds the 1974 Black American Racers Association yearbook (Trenton, NJ) in its physical collection, but the Open Access API record has no associated online_media / image, so no downloadable file of the actual publication exists.

name: Spirit: The Guide to the Soul
MEDIC News
source: Internet Archive (Gus Heningburg Collection, Newark Public Library)
whyMatch: Digitized item is titled exactly "MEDIC News vol. 1 no. 1", described as the newsletter of Minority Economic Development and Cultural Enterprises, Inc. (matches MEDIC acronym), part of the Gus Heningburg Collection held by the Charles F. Cummings New Jersey Information Center at Newark Public Library. Right title, right city (Newark), plausible era. A companion issue (Heningburg167, vol.1 no.2) also exists.
caption: MEDIC News, vol. 1, no. 1 — 8-page newsletter, Newark, NJ. Gus Heningburg Collection, Charles F. Cummings New Jersey Information Center, Newark Public Library.

name: The Cricket: Black Music in Evolution
whyMatch: Only a 2022 Blank Forms Editions facsimile reprint (a modern book, not the original 1968-69 mimeograph) was found for sale; no digitized scan of an original issue located.

name: Hours After
